name: search_products
description: Search for products across the marketplace by keyword, category, or filters

prime_only.description: Only show items with free fast shipping

returns: List of products with name, price, rating, review count, availability, and thumbnail

name: get_product_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific product
returns: Full product details including description, specifications, images, variants, seller info, and shipping options

name: get_product_reviews
description: Get customer reviews for a specific product

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return

returns: List of reviews with rating, text, reviewer, date, verified purchase status, and helpfulness

name: add_to_cart
description: Add a product to the shopping cart
returns: Updated cart contents with item count and subtotal

name: remove_from_cart
description: Remove a product from the shopping cart

product_id.description: Unique identifier of the product to remove

returns: Updated cart contents with item count and subtotal

name: get_cart
description: Retrieve the current contents of the shopping cart

include_recommendations.description: Include product recommendations based on cart

returns: Cart contents with items, quantities, prices, subtotal, tax estimate, and shipping estimate

name: update_cart_quantity
description: Update the quantity of an item in the shopping cart
returns: Updated cart contents with new subtotal

name: place_order
description: Place an order for items in the shopping cart

shipping_address_id.description: ID of the shipping address to use

payment_method_id.description: ID of the payment method to use

returns: Order confirmation with order_id, items, total, estimated delivery date

name: track_order
description: Track the shipping status of an order
returns: Tracking details with status, carrier, tracking number, location history, and estimated delivery

name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an order that has not yet shipped

order_id.description: Unique identifier of the order to cancel

returns: Cancellation confirmation with refund amount and timeline

name: return_item
description: Initiate a return for a delivered item
returns: Return authorization with return_id, shipping label, refund estimate, and instructions

name: get_order_history
description: Get the user's past orders

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return

returns: List of orders with order_id, date, items, total, status, and tracking info

name: compare_products
description: Compare multiple products side by side on specifications and price

product_ids.description: List of product IDs to compare

returns: Side-by-side comparison table of products across specified criteria

name: add_to_wishlist
description: Add a product to the user's wishlist
returns: Confirmation that product was added to wishlist

name: get_wishlist
description: Retrieve the user's wishlist items

include_price_changes.description: Show price changes since item was added

returns: List of wishlist items with current price, availability, and price change alerts

name: apply_coupon
description: Apply a coupon or promotional code to the shopping cart

coupon_code.description: Coupon or promo code to apply

returns: Discount applied, new subtotal, and any restrictions or limitations

name: get_shipping_estimate
description: Get shipping cost and delivery time estimates for a product or cart
returns: Shipping options with cost, estimated delivery date, and carrier for each method

name: check_product_availability
description: Check if a product is in stock and available for purchase
returns: Stock status, quantity available, restock date if out of stock, and nearby store availability

name: get_price_history
description: Get historical price data for a product
returns: Price history with dates, lowest price, highest price, average, and current price relative to history

name: set_price_drop_alert
description: Set an alert to be notified when a product's price drops
returns: Alert confirmation with current price and alert_id

name: submit_product_review
description: Submit a review for a purchased product

photos.description: Photo URLs to include with review

returns: Review confirmation with review_id

name: get_seller_info
description: Get information about a marketplace seller
returns: Seller details including name, rating, response time, return policy, and product count

name: contact_seller
description: Send a message to a product seller
returns: Message sent confirmation with conversation_id and expected response time

name: get_recommendations
description: Get personalized product recommendations based on browsing and purchase history
returns: List of recommended products with relevance score and reason for recommendation

name: manage_shipping_address
description: Add, update, or delete a shipping address
returns: Updated address details or confirmation of action

name: subscribe_to_product
description: Set up a recurring subscription for a consumable product
returns: Subscription confirmation with subscription_id, next delivery date, and discount applied

name: get_deals_of_the_day
description: Get current deals, flash sales, and limited-time offers

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return

returns: List of current deals with product, original price, sale price, discount percentage, and time remaining

name: ask_product_question
description: Ask a question about a product on its listing page
returns: Question submission confirmation and any existing answers to similar questions

name: calculate_total
description: Calculate the total cost of the current cart including tax, shipping, and discounts

zip_code.description: Destination ZIP code for tax and shipping calculation

returns: Detailed cost breakdown with subtotal, tax, shipping, discounts, and grand total

name: get_return_status
description: Check the status of a return request
returns: Return status, refund amount, refund method, and estimated refund date
